items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I worked there with Red Norvo too.

ctx.x: Oh, you did hear it. You don't object when you can catch it on the tube. Well listen, we are getting near to the time when you find yourself going off to Australia. How did that come about?

Well, I was working up in San Francisco, and Dorothy, that's my sister, she called me and she said, 'well I just booked you down in Austrialia'. I said, 'well you must be going down there to sing because I ain't going way down there'. She said, 'yes you are now. You have to go'. I said, 'who am I going with?' She said, Red Norvo. And I said, 'shucks, I ain't going down there'. She said, 'yes you are because I told them on television that you was coming and now you got to go'. When I came on back here I went to…
